textos.As opiniões divergem sobre o funcionamen: Opinions diverge on how well the script and structure work. While about half of those who recommend it find charm in the everyday life and the simplicity of the events, about half of those who do not recommend it consider the pacing drawn out and monotonous, pointing to superficiality in the development of the plot and the characters.
textos.A lentidão e a ausência de eventos relev: The slowness and the lack of relevant events make the experience boring, making the viewer struggle to keep paying attention.
textos.Há uma crítica incisiva à forma como a o: There is sharp criticism of the way the film ennobles a cleaner's life, ignoring the structural conditions and the toll of the work, and it is compared to a gentrification advertisement.
textos.Falta de profundidade narrativa e person: Lack of narrative depth and shallow characters
textos.O filme falha em desenvolver o protagoni: The film fails to develop the protagonist or any dramatic arc, settling for superficial situations that do not generate engagement.
textos.Apesar das críticas, muitos reconhecem a: Despite the criticism, many acknowledge the beauty of the images and the good music selection, which help create a pleasant atmosphere.
textos.A ideia de encontrar felicidade nas pequ: The idea of finding happiness in small things is seen as hackneyed and repetitive, without bringing a new perspective or philosophical depth.
textos.A reta final é apontada como um dos pior: The final stretch is pointed to as one of the worst moments, whether for being poorly constructed, for forced symbolism or for not bringing a satisfying conclusion.
textos.Muitos espectadores consideraram a rotin: Many viewers considered the protagonist's routine excessively repetitive, which made the experience tiring and even boring, although some acknowledged that this repetition served the narrative purpose.
textos.O filme transmite uma mensagem edificant: The film conveys an uplifting message about finding beauty and contentment in the simple details of everyday life, a philosophy of life that many viewers found touching and inspiring.
textos.A direção de arte e a fotografia foram a: The art direction and the cinematography were widely praised, especially the lighting, the Japanese architecture and the composition of the shots, which created a visually pleasant and contemplative atmosphere.
textos.Alguns espectadores sentiram que o filme: Some viewers felt that the film did not adequately explore the protagonist's past or psychology, leaving questions open and preventing a deeper connection with the character.
textos.Representação idealizada do trabalho e d: Idealized portrayal of work and solitude
textos.Houve críticas quanto à romantização do: There was criticism of the romanticization of cleaning work and solitary life, with some pointing out that the reality of these situations is much harder, which made the film's approach unrealistic or problematic.
textos.A performance do ator principal foi dest: The lead actor's performance was highlighted as exceptional, conveying a range of emotions through subtle gestures and facial expressions, especially in the quietest scenes and in the film's conclusion.
textos.Beleza na rotina e nas pequenas coisas: Beauty in routine and small things
textos.As reviews positivas destacam que o film: The positive reviews highlight that the film finds poetry and meaning in daily repetition, valuing small gestures, the light through the leaves, the music, the books and the simplicity of everyday life.
textos.Muitas reviews elogiam a fotografia, com: Many reviews praise the cinematography, with beautiful colors, scenes of Tokyo, the play of light and shadow, and the use of black-and-white images.
textos.As reviews ressaltam que a atuação do pr: The reviews stress that the protagonist's performance is striking even with very little dialogue, conveying emotion through subtle expressions and gestures.
textos.Algumas reviews mencionam que o ritmo va: Some reviews mention that the slow pace can be challenging, but that immersion in the character's life pays off, making the experience almost meditative.
textos.Felicidade encontrada na solitude e intr: Happiness found in solitude and introspection
textos.As reviews positivas apontam que o filme: The positive reviews point out that the film celebrates solitude as a space of peace and self-knowledge, showing that it is possible to be happy without great external achievements.
textos.As reviews destacam a capacidade do film: The reviews highlight the film's ability to balance happiness and sadness, reminding us that a good life can contain both, as in the final scene that mixes tears and a smile.

textos.Dirigido por Wim Wenders, o drama Dias P: Directed by Wim Wenders, the drama Perfect Days (2023) follows Hirayama, a reflective middle-aged man who lives modestly as a custodian, cleaning public restrooms in Tokyo. The protagonist's daily life is revealed through his three passions — the music he listens to, the books he reads and the photos he takes of trees —, until unexpected encounters begin to appear and suggest dimensions of a past that was not so methodical.
textos.A narrativa adota um ritmo lento e caden: The narrative adopts a slow, measured pace, structured around the repetition of daily chores and the urban setting constant in the city's public spaces.
textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~92%), a ma: In the vast majority of ratings (~92%), most highlight that the film finds poetry and beauty in routine and in the small things in life. Within this same set, a significant share praises the cinematography and visual aesthetics, while a smaller slice stresses Koji Yakusho's minimalist performance, driven by subtle expressions and almost no dialogue.
textos.Para quem está situado numa fração mínim: For those in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~7%), the perception is divided: a considerable number point out that the slow pace and repetition make the experience tiring, while several find the message of valuing simplicity touching, and a portion stresses the visual beauty and the cinematography.
textos.Na perspectiva de quem compõe uma fração: From the perspective of those making up an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~2%), more emphatic objections arise: for a good portion, the slow pace and the lack of events generate boredom, many criticize the romanticization of work and routine, and some point to a lack of narrative depth combined with shallow characters.
